pages.text: Today is cookie day. Coco rolled the dough thin.
Coco chose a star-shaped cutter. Press it down, and out comes a star.
Mrs. Magpie said from the windowsill, "Moons are prettier."
As Coco cut out stars, she kept pushing a moon cutter toward Coco.
"I like stars." Coco cut out another star.
The tray filled with little stars. Mrs. Magpie stuck out her beak.
The cookies went into the oven. A delicious smell spread through the room.
The golden star cookies came out. Coco sprinkled them with sparkling sugar.
Mrs. Magpie quietly picked up one. Crunch.
"...Stars aren't bad either." Sugar sparkled on the tip of her beak.
